text:
Lina: Hey all, first-day laptop weirdness. Enrolled via Okta on my M1 Pro (macOS 14.1) and MDM shows 'FileVault required', but System Settings says FileVault: Off and when I try to enable it I get 'Failed to escrow recovery key' error. Keychain shows 'Redwood MDM' cert with a warning. Blocker for dev setup (need docker). Anyone seen this?

Hayden (IT): Welcome! Sorry about that. Two common causes: 1) user account doesn't have Secure Token, or 2) the MDM cert isn't trusted so the escrow attempt fails. Can you paste output of `fdesetup status` and `sysadminctl -secureTokenStatus $(whoami)`? Also are you on home Wi-Fi or on VPN?

Lina: On home Wi-Fi. Outputs: 
`$ fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is Off. No user is enabled for FileVault."
`$ sysadminctl -secureTokenStatus lina` -> "User lina does not have Secure Token"
Also in Keychain Access the 'Redwood MDM Root' under System Roots shows a red X.

Jules (Buddy): @Lina I hit something like this. IT fixed it by pushing the trust anchor and then enabling FV via the MDM console. Took like 5 min.

Hayden (IT): OK that matches. Because your account is SSO-only it didn't get a Secure Token at creation. We can do either: A) create a temporary local admin and grant your account a Secure Token with `sysadminctl -adminUser <adm> -adminPassword <pw> -secureTokenOn lina -password <linaPW>`, or B) if the device is supervised we can push FV enable with institutional escrow after we make sure the Redwood CA is trusted. Since you prefer not to handle creds, I'll try B. First I'll push a trusted root cert and then retry escrow.

MDM Bot: Pushing certificate profile 'Redwood Root CA' to device id f1c3b8. Then attempting FileVault enable (escrow) for device f1c3b8.

Hayden (IT): You should see a modal asking to allow MDM to enable FileVault using org recovery key. Click Accept and enter your macOS password once.

Lina: I got the modal, clicked Accept, entered password. It showed 'Enabling FileVault...' and asked to reboot. Rebooted.

Lina: Post-reboot checks: `fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is On. Users enabled for FileVault: - lina" and System Settings now shows FileVault: On. No more cert warnings. Docker installs fine.

Hayden (IT): Great. Closing note for the channel: if you see 'Failed to escrow recovery key' check that the Redwood Root CA is trusted in System Roots and whether your account has a Secure Token. If SSO-only accounts lack Secure Token we prefer the MDM institutional escrow flow on supervised devices to avoid sharing admin creds. File a ticket if your device is unsupervised.

Jules (Buddy): Welcome aboard Lina :tada:

MDM Bot: Ticket IT-1310: Cert profile pushed and FileVault enabled via escrow for device f1c3b8.
